notes.title: Update v017
notes.content:
v017
Breakable vases

Different plant effects, dizzy post processing shader

New rune puzzle waypoint

Slots in waypoints that are procedurally filled with different props

Each attack now moves player forward slightly, with adjusted animations

Reworked music

Parry and pick plants now part of the tutorial

Portal and cairn sounds

Improved Trokar voice acting

Optimized grass and minimap, boosting fps +20
